name: Jude
bio: Judas (Jude), one of Jesus's brothers along with James, Joses, and Simon, is named by the skeptical people of Nazareth who took offense at Jesus's teaching despite knowing his humble family (Matthew 13:55-57). He is a different figure from Judas Iscariot; his later authorship of the Epistle of Jude is told in the books ahead.
